description: A test class for verifying Room database migrations in an Android app. It contains tests to ensure that migrations from various versions can be applied successfully, including sequential upgrades and specific migration steps.

classes.name: DatabaseMigrationTest
classes.description: Test class for verifying that database migration scripts work correctly and the database can be upgraded across versions without errors.

methods.name: testAllMigrations
methods.description: Creates a database with all migrations from version 1 to 5 and verifies it can be opened.

methods.name: testMigration2To3
methods.description: Creates a database with migration from version 2 to 3 and verifies it can be opened.

methods.name: testMigration3To4
methods.description: Creates a database with migration from version 3 to 4 and verifies it can be opened.

methods.name: testMigration4To5
methods.description: Creates a database with migration from version 4 to 5 and verifies it can be opened.

methods.name: testMigration3To5
methods.description: Creates a database that applies migrations from version 3 directly to 5, simulating an upgrade skipping version 4, and verifies it can be opened.
